objective_contribution: Advance LongMemEval useful-state evidence independently while preparing permissively licensed preference and original selectivity branches; preserve GLM/ContextBench objectives.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does ledger-backed source-linked sequential memory improve native answers over ordinary bounded notes?

measurement_mapping.native: Keep each benchmark metric separate; pilot counts do not establish official scores.
measurement_mapping.retention: LongMemEval oracle evaluates supplied relevant evidence, not long-history retrieval.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Pin sources; isolate gold, state, arms and splits.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative input plus output across generator, extractor and judge; no byte proxy.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Small benchmark subsets test bounded transfer; format offer utility remains separate.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Preserve GLM small-window chapter and existing larger-window ContextBench order; independent preference pilot.

retained_counterevidence: 105 contract tests do not establish semantic benefit.
Narrow lexical detector may abstain on every external task.
Oracle history cannot prove useful retrieval or provider compaction behavior.
Scope and replacement bugs were fixed in prior construction; preserve their tests.
PrefEval and BenchPreS are excluded from successor execution; preserve v1 selection history.
PersonaMem original histories exceed the proposed 8K budget in some cases; adaptation requires an explicit protocol.
Original all-history LongMemEval and PersonaMem remain blocked; this freeze admits only the explicit LongMemEval sequential successor.
Sequential notes may lose source facts or exhaust completion cap; native rubric requires blind semantic review.
successor_rule: Invalid instrumentation returns to construction; valid failure revises hypothesis; valid improvement requires fresh reserved freeze.
